entities.name: UE error handling procedure for mandatory IE errors
entities.description: UE procedure for handling errors encountered with mandatory information elements in ESM messages. Specifies different rejection messages based on the received request type.

entities.name: Network error handling procedure for mandatory IE errors
entities.description: Network procedure for handling errors encountered with mandatory information elements in ESM messages. Specifies different rejection messages based on the received request type.

entities.name: ESM cause
entities.description: Information element used to indicate the cause of ESM procedure failure. Value #96 indicates 'invalid mandatory information'.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by UE to reject an ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by UE to reject an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by UE to reject a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: ESM message sent by UE in response to DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected, causing release of all associated EPS bearer resources.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by network to reject a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by network to reject a PDN DISCONNECT REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by network to reject a BEARER RESOURCE ALLOCATION REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REJECT
entities.description: ESM message sent by network to reject a BEARER RESOURCE MODIFICATION REQUEST when mandatory IE error is detected.

entities.name: Mandatory IE error condition
entities.description: Condition where a mandatory information element in an ESM message contains an error.

entities.name: EPS bearer resource release
entities.description: Property where all resources associated with an EPS bearer are released when DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT is sent due to mandatory IE error.
